**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE THIRTY-SEVEN RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION (§29e/§46/§53/§56.4). 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` (§29c). 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS (§56.3). 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD ON WHAT IS ON THE MAP. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): **`TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME.** 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY GATE THAT ASKS "IS THIS MAP READY YET". 21 (§58): **THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT.** 22 (§59): **A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT.** 23 (§60): **AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL.** 24 (§61a): **CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR.** 25 (§61b): **A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED.** 26 (§61f): **EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE SAME "IS IT DRAWN" GATE THE RENDERER USES.** 27 (§62c): **PREFER THE OPERATION EVERY HOST IS ALREADY FORCED TO HANDLE (SPAWN/DESPAWN) OVER THE ONE EACH HOST HANDLES ITS OWN WAY (FLICK).** 28 (§63a): **A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE.** 29 (§0b): **REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS.** 30 (§66d): **A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER.** 31 (§66f): **WHEN A GUARDED HANDOFF FAILS IN THE FIELD, MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED.** 32 (§69a): **TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT.** 33 (§62k): **A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO - `work=0 | skip:(none)` IS A CONTRADICTION, NOT A CLEAN RUN.** 34 (§62l): **AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER, NOT JUST THE MAP MESH - `DrawerType.None` IS FILTERED IN `SectionLayer_Things.Regenerate`, SO IT CAN NEVER APPEAR IN AN OVERLAY EITHER. Corollary: the map mesh and each overlay are SEPARATE METHODS, so one can be suppressed without the other.** 35 (§62n): **MAKING A CLONED FOREIGN DEF VISIBLE ENTERS IT INTO EVERY FOREIGN LOOKUP THE HOST BUILT FROM ITS OWN AUTHORED LISTS - AND IT IS IN NONE OF THEM.** 36 (§70a): **WHEN WE SPAWN SOMETHING VANILLA NORMALLY SPAWNS, WE MUST RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE, NOT A SUMMARY OF IT.** 37 (§71a): **NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. Read the engine's own handler for the transition you are predicting.**

**DESIGN (user-locked):** 4 typed columns, MERGE ONLY (metering permanently declined; "one inter-connected base"), per-network disconnect gizmos, one level per column (stack for more), research Electricity + Machining, flat cost Steel 60 + Comp 2, HARD DELETE of risers (no converter; user chose this).

**62.A TYPES:** POWER, PIPE (all fluids AND gases), CLIMATE, DATA. **62.B CLASSIFIER:** forcedType → id=="Power" → keywords on id+template defName+label, ORDER Power / Data / Climate → default Pipe. ⚠ "cool" NOT "cold". ⚠ NO "gas" keyword. ⚠ NEVER classify on `resource.unit` (Helixien GAS declares `l`). FIELD-VERIFIED 9/9 correct.
**62.C BUILDING** (`Building_ABColumn`): vanilla-Column-shaped (holdsRoof, PassThroughOnly, fill 0.25, Structure). AUTO-CONNECT on first construction, `autoEnabled` scribed (rule 8). Toggle = spawn/despawn carrier pair (rule 27). ⚠ STACKS SHARE CARRIERS: claimants = column IN the cell + column one Slot BELOW. ⚠ Carriers destroyable=false: DeSpawn only.
**62.D LINK** (`ABColumnLink`): partner = same `ABCarrierExt.network` at cell ± Slot; spawned == live.
**62.E DELETED:** 30 riser defs, root Compat/, 90 riser PNGs, CompABRiserSwitch, PlaceWorker_ABOnWall, ABDevTools.V2Risers, Building_ABPowerBreaker, PokeRebuild, LoadFolders gates.
**62.F ART:** user-generated via Nano Banana Pro, 4 files, 1200x896 RGBA; originals in `.modmixer/art-src/` (git-backed). ⚠ drawSize x MUST stay 1.34*y ((1.61,1.2) + z offset 0.18).
**62.G CARRIER GEN:** probes + `ABColumnAdapterDef` escape hatch → clone host conduit → carrier def at `GenerateImpliedDefs_PreResolve`, `AddImpliedDef` PINNED to ThingDef. FIELD-VERIFIED: 9 networks, 9 carriers, 0 skipped, every template a plain conduit.
**62.H DATA ADAPTERS:** RimIOT = postfix on `RebuildAllNetworks`, merge-by-removal member by member, winner caches rebuilt via the host's own surface. ⚠ Safe because its 500-tick audits are MEMBER-based not spatial. Eccentric = postfix `InitConduit` calling their private `MergeNetworks`, plus postfix `DeregisterConduit` setting `dirty=true` because their cardinal-only split CANNOT dissolve a cross-band union.
**62.I ROOF:** `holdsRoof` means "can SUPPORT a roof", never "makes one". A column in the open had none, so `ABSkySync.Resolve` fell to `AB_WallTop` - buildable but IMPASSABLE. Fix: lay a REAL `RoofConstructed` on the column's own cell (§45's recipe, as `Building_ABStairs2` does), so `Patch_RoofGrid_ABSyncAbove` re-derives the cell above as walkable `AB_RoofSurface`. `roofPlaced` scribed; DeSpawn takes back only our own roof (rule 8); existing roofs never overwritten.
**62.J VISIBLE CARRIERS:** dropped slice 1's forced `DrawerType.None`. One field fixed two requests: columns appear in network overlays, AND the up-cell carrier IS the visible "conduit on the floor above" with no second def and no auto-construction to balance. Linking survives the clone (`graphicData.linkFlags`, not defName) - **for hosts that resolve art from the def. VEF PipeSystem does not: see §62.N.**
**62.M HIDE UNDER COLUMN** (`Patch_SectionLayer_ABHideCarrierUnderColumn`): a carrier sharing a cell with a `Building_ABColumn` skips printing to the GENERAL layer only. ⚠ The map mesh (`SectionLayer_ThingsGeneral.TakePrintFrom` → `Thing.Print`) and the power overlay (`SectionLayer_ThingsPowerGrid.TakePrintFrom` → `PrintForPowerGrid` → `CompPrintForPowerGrid`) are DIFFERENT METHODS, so suppressing one leaves every overlay untouched. Condition is "a column stands here", which self-maintains for stacks. `ABColumnNetworks.IsCarrier` is a HashSet for the render hot path.
**62.K DBH PREFIX MISMATCH = RULE 33:** §62's probe builds ids from the NAMESPACE, the riser-era filter carried the literal "DBH." - fix: prefix DERIVED (`compName.Split('.')[0] + "."`), plus narration for "no id matched" and "matched but no carrier".
**62.L TELEMETRY:** `AB2: network scan` (Debug Actions MENU) prints every network with type/probe/template/carrier/research, MERGE COUNTERS one row per family each with a lastSkip clause, **HOST ART BINDING (§62.N)**, then COLUMNS ON THIS MAP per column. ⚠ Power had NO counters through the first field test; that gap is why rule 33 exists.

**62.N HOST ART BINDING - SHIPPED (window 8), FIELD-UNVERIFIED** (`ABPipeGraphics` in `Source/Compat/PipeSystemCompat.cs`). `Building_Pipe.Graphic` = `LinkedPipes.GetPipeFor(def)`, an unguarded `Dictionary<ThingDef, Graphic_LinkedPipe>` built in a `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]` cctor from every `PipeNetDef.pipeDefs` - the AUTHORED list; our runtime-clone carriers are in none. Fix = one dictionary write per carrier mapping to the graphic the host built for the template we cloned (same shared object). ⚠ REJECTED appending to `pipeDefs` (authorizes drag-deconstruct on destroyable=false + foreign-cctor texPath walk = TypeInitializationException risk, rule 14). ⚠ TIMING via `RuntimeHelpers.RunClassConstructor` (idempotent), re-run `[ABGameReset(60)]`. ⚠ SELECTOR = object-keyed `IDictionary` indexer (null, never throws). Narration `PipeSystem: bound=N already=N skippedNonVE=N | skip: …`. ⚠ Other families survived because their def-keyed cache uses `TryGetValue` - only ART was missing. Generalization = rule 35, ledger 20.

# 70. BAND FLORA LEGALITY - SHIPPED (window 8), FIELD-UNVERIFIED (`Source/V2/ABBandFlora.cs`; callers `ABCavernGen` step 6 and `ABSkyBandGen.SeedFlora`)

*Cause - one hole, three symptoms:* both band seeders gated candidates on nothing but `plant.fertilityMin > terrain.fertility`; vanilla runs `PlantUtility.CanEverPlantAt` (`wildTerrainTags`, `terrainBlacklist`, `completelyIgnoreFertility`, pollution). (1) Biomes! flora died on wrong-tag terrain via `Plant.DyingBecauseOfTerrainTags` 0.005/tick, no log line (rule 36). (2) `Mud`/`Marsh` fertility 0 tripped our `<= 0.01 → skip` gate - wet ground bare, wet species dumped on dry soil. (3) The old loop abandoned the CELL when its one random draw was illegal.

*Fix.* `ABFloraPicker`: per-biome pool, terrain-keyed candidate cache, weighted draw from the legal set, real `CanEverPlantAt` as the last word. `FertilityWeightOn` reproduces vanilla's `GetBaseDesiredPlantsCountAt` shape incl. the **0.1 water floor** for `completelyIgnoreFertility` biomes.

⚠ **`Mud` STAYING BARE IS CORRECT.** Do not "fix" it. ⚠ **MAP-TEMPERATURE CLAUSE = TOTAL-REJECTION RISK (rule 33):** empty strict pool is rebuilt without that clause, ANNOUNCED. ⚠ **SCRATCH BUFFER IS PER-INSTANCE** (§57f).

## 70.B CAVERN REGROWTH - OPEN, PRICED, NOT STARTED (ledger 5b)

Bands are roofed `RoofRockThick` → `GoodRoofForCavePlant` TRUE everywhere → vanilla regrows glowstool (global `allCavePlants`) over Biomes! species (`cavePlantWeight 0`). *Fix = three coupled patches, none sufficient alone:* **A** postfix `cachedPlantCommonalities` build; **B** postfix `GetCommonalityOfPlant` (MAP level, no ambient latch); **C** transpile the `GoodRoofForCavePlant(c)` call inside `CheckSpawnWildPlantAt` (⚠ NOT a postfix: `CanRegrowAt` uses it with OPPOSITE polarity). ⚠ **DO NOT SHIP A PARTIAL** (C alone stops basement regrowth entirely). Knock-on: A shifts SURFACE cluster maths (§60 audit, ledger 14).

# 71. SMOOTH TERRAIN / NANAME FLOORS - RESOLVED (window 8), baseline compatible unmodified, user-verified. UPSTREAM REPORT AWAITING PASTE (ledger 5c). Mechanism (rule 37 correction): their blends LOSE `tags` from one side and `TerrainGrid.DoTerrainChangedEffects` INSTANTLY `Destroy()`s mismatched plants on the swap - reproduces WITHOUT us. Report at `docs/UPSTREAM_SmoothTerrain.md` (suggests `tags` union in `ValidateAndHardenDef`). Our guard postfix REJECTED as a foreign-pair workaround. ⚠ Blend-def population: auto-detect can mint thousands of runtime TerrainDefs (rule 4) - any whole-`DefDatabase<TerrainDef>` walk must remember.

# 72. LINK GIZMO ICONS + AUTO-SELECT + CAMERA CUT - ✅ SHIPPED (window 8), USER-VERIFIED

User-supplied 128px icons at `Textures/UI/AB_ViewLevelUp/Down.png`, declared in `.modmixer/cs-assets.json`; `ABTex` (`[StaticConstructorOnStartup]`). `Building_ABStairs2.GetGizmos`: icon by counterpart direction; action = `ABBandView.JumpTo` + `ClearSelection` + `Select(cp)`. Elevator = one gizmo per linked level. **72.b PAN→CUT:** JumpTo reads the old band BEFORE writing `bands.viewBand`, passes `Cut` on band change. ⚠ Lesson: a guard patch keyed on "state differs" is defeated by any caller that updates the state first - decide the mode where the state is written.
